Wednesday evening traffic: Highway 9 lane closures, one-way traffic in SLV

This post is updated throughout the day to reflect the latest incidents. It was last updated at 9:31 p.m..

Here’s what’s happening on the roads this evening…

▼︎ new incidents

Road incidents as of 9:30 p.m. on July 22

  • CHP helped with construction work at the intersection of Highway 1 South and Park in Capitola/Soquel today.
     
  • Highway 9 at Cascade Avenue in San Lorenzo Valley has one-way traffic due to ongoing work. This closure will last until August 31 at 7:01 a.m.
     
  • Highway 9 at Pool Drive in San Lorenzo Valley has alternating lane closures in both directions because of bridge work. This will continue until April 30, 2027, at 6:59 a.m.
     

Disclosure: Traffic incidents are partially generated by artificial intelligence. We are constantly working to improve the accuracy and quality of our AI-generated content. However, there may still be errors or inaccuracies. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us.
